Changes since v0.2.48:
- Updates open a What's new window with three to five items, and a release without a summary is refused (#249) - Shipping a release refuses a skipped version or a build number that does not rise (#247) - Comment and guide stop naming the deleted release scripts (ENS-171) (#246) - The release docs name only the auto-release workflow and the two launchd release scripts are deleted (#245) - Tests pin the switch-off wait at 8 seconds and the send wait cap at 1.2 seconds (#243) - Playwright-core 1.64.1 lockfile and a Dependabot entry for the website test folder (ENS-155, hand steps) (#241) - The site publish step copies the app's 3D and tracker files (ENS-168, hand step) (#240) - The contributor guide lists check-update-signature.sh and ci runs its test (ENS-170) (#239) - The home page shows the requirements and the Open Anyway note under the hero Download button and links Claude desktop (#238) - A Playwright test runs the home page and the live demo in Firefox and in WebKit (#237) - Update (#236) - The agent guide says the release workflow is the only automatic release path and the launchd agent is retired (#235) - The size budget rises from 9,000,000 to 9,500,000 bytes (#234) - The contributor guide says the launchd release agent is retired (ENS-157) (#233) - The website-tests and gate checks allow 15 minutes instead of 5 (ENS-121) (#232)

item.description:
Changes since v0.2.47:
- Update (#231) - A written first-run walkthrough and a live-website script follow a new person from the link to the first gesture (#230) - A refused camera now says the camera is needed and shows how to allow it in Safari, Firefox and Chrome (#229) - The home page headline and text now stop before the 3D scene at 1100, 1500 and 1920 px wide (#228) - The docs say the required checks run the usage triage tests on every pull request (#226) - The changelog says the auto-release workflow is the only automatic release path (#225) - The docs name the library release dry run as the Linux and Windows test check (#224) - The gotchas list states the signing certificate expiry date and the Developer ID grant reset (#223) - The portability page no longer states test counts and says where to read them (#222) - The home page hero tours the main screen, the side screen's top session and its non-Claude bottom window before it loops (#221) - The release guide states the signing certificate expires on 2036-10-11 (#220)

Changes since v0.2.46:
- The nose dot aims up to 40 ms ahead while it moves, and asks for 120 Hz only while moving fast (#218) - The built app drops Sparkle's 35 unused update-window translations and keeps the English one (#217)
